lines: Developers struggle to give AI agents specialized marketing knowledge for tasks like copy or SEO.
It installs specialized skills so AI agents can handle B2B cold emails, SEO audits, and growth engineering tasks.
Skills are markdown files installed to give agents specialized workflows that reference each other for shared context.
Just ask 'optimize this landing page for conversions' to trigger conversion skills.
v2.0 consolidates page-cro and form-cro into one single cro skill.
It tracks 140 SaaS marketing ideas and manages churn prevention flows.
It sets up analytics tracking and manages a full lead lifecycle for sales teams.
You can install via CLI, clone a fork to customize it, or use SkillKit for multiple agents.
The license is MIT and creators use this repo across many projects.
Clone the repo or run this command to install all marketing skills.
Send this to someone who needs AI marketing skills.
Get specialized marketing skills for your AI agents today.
